alias.rationale: Creates or modifies nvm alias mappings in configuration; state change is bounded and reversible.

current.rationale: Displays the currently active Node version without modifying any state.

deactivate.rationale: Disables nvm in the current shell session; modifies active environment state but is reversible.

exec.rationale: The 'exec' is the safe sense of execute/run-code-with-a-version, not the shell builtin; executing code may modify state but operations are boundedly reversible, not irreversible destruction.

install.rationale: Downloads and installs a Node version; modifies filesystem but is bounded and reversible (can uninstall).

list.rationale: Displays locally installed Node versions without modifying any state.

list-remote.rationale: Queries and displays available remote Node versions without modifying any state.

run.rationale: The 'run' is the safe sense of execute-code, not a dangerous operation; code execution may modify state but is boundedly reversible, not irreversible destruction.

unalias.rationale: Removes an alias mapping from configuration; minor, reversible state change.

uninstall.rationale: Deletes an installed Node version from the filesystem; destructive operation matching the dangerous category.

use.rationale: Switches the active Node version; modifies shell environment state but is reversible.

which.rationale: Displays the path to the currently active Node executable without modifying any state.
